description: Use this when the user wants a helicopter experience in Japan, whether or not they mention OlaChill: a Tokyo helicopter tour or sightseeing flight (including short 10–30 minute flights), a night-view flight, a Mt Fuji, Yokohama, Osaka or Kyoto helicopter flight, a private helicopter charter for a proposal, anniversary or special occasion, or a heli-taxi or helicopter transfer between two points. Returns each flight's area, duration, seats, whether seats are sold one by one or only as the whole aircraft, the 'from' price in JPY, the departure heliport, whether OlaChill confirms the slot with the operator, and the booking page. Read-only. Do not use it for airline flights between cities or countries, for ground transport, or for tours that do not involve a helicopter (use search_travel_products).

area.description: Where the flight takes place. Omit to list all areas.

locale.description: Language for product names and page links (en, ja, ko, zh = Simplified Chinese, tw = Traditional Chinese, es, fr, de, it, th, id, vi). Default en.

passengers.description: Party size, used to drop flights whose aircraft cannot carry the group.

service_type.description: sightseeing = loop flight returning to the same heliport; transfer = point-to-point helicopter ride. Default any.

time_of_day.description: Daytime or night-view flights. Default any.

name: search_helicopter_experiences

error.description: Present only when the call failed; a short reason the user can act on.

confirmation_required.description: True when OlaChill confirms the slot with the operator before the flight is final.

price_from.description: Price in the stated currency; null when no reliable price is published.

unit.description: What the price covers, e.g. per_person, per_vehicle, per_vehicle_per_day, per_aircraft, per_group.

title: Find helicopter flights
